title: What are you going to do?

dialogue.speaker: Gulim
dialogue.text: Aibek! Exams are finally over! What are you going to do now?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: First I'm going to sleep for about twelve hours! Then I'm going to pack and go home to Aktau.

dialogue.speaker: Gulim
dialogue.text: Lovely! How long are you going to stay in Aktau?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: About three weeks. I'm going to be with my family and go to the Caspian Sea every day!

dialogue.speaker: Gulim
dialogue.text: That sounds amazing. I'm not going to go home straight away — I'm going to visit Almaty first.

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Almaty? What are you going to do there?

dialogue.speaker: Gulim
dialogue.text: I'm going to visit a famous architecture firm — they offered me a tour. And I'm going to see a school friend who lives there.

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: That's great! After Almaty, are you going to go home to Shymkent?

dialogue.speaker: Gulim
dialogue.text: Yes — I'm going to spend the last two weeks of summer with my parents. My mum is going to teach me her special beshbarmak recipe!

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Ha! And next semester — do you have any academic plans?

dialogue.speaker: Gulim
dialogue.text: I'm going to work on a big architecture project and start learning AutoCAD properly. You?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: I'm going to study much more systematically. Better grades next semester — that's my goal!

dialogue.speaker: Gulim
dialogue.text: Good idea! We should make a study group. Are you going to be free on Thursday evenings?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Definitely! Let's do it. We're going to have the best second year ever!

task1Items.question: Aibek's first plan after exams is to sleep for about twelve hours.
Aibek is going to spend two weeks in Aktau with his family.
Gulim is going to go straight home to Shymkent immediately after exams.
Gulim is going to visit a famous architecture firm during her time in Almaty.
Gulim's mother is going to teach her to make beshbarmak.
Aibek and Gulim decide to form a study group that meets on Thursday evenings.
